name: GAN356 i Carry 4 3x3 (Frosted, 2026 Year of the Horse Edition)
description: Celebrate the 2026 Year of the Horse with the exclusive GAN356 i Carry 4 3x3 (Frosted, 2026 Year of the Horse Edition)! This special release features a unique design inspired by "Horsie," GAN’s official mascot for the Year of the Horse. The cube comes in a collectible box with festive artwork, orange internal plastic, a signature orange logo center cap, and a matching cube bag.
